summary: Frontend e2e test of CRM Master Price List mapping-template toolbar (iter 220p1) — Save / Apply / Preview. All three acceptance scenarios PASS on the preview env. Template 'ACME QA Template' was created via window.prompt against acme_name_only.xlsx (sheet 'Catalogue 2026'), appears in the apply dropdown (which was correctly disabled with text 'No templates yet' before any save), applies without error, and the wizard reaches the Preview step (3 rows, 3 ready, 0 errors).
critical_code_review_comments: applyTemplate() silently no-ops if templateId not found in templates state — fine, but no user feedback. Consider a brief toast.
saveTemplate uses window.prompt which is blocked by some browsers/CSP and is jarring UX. Acceptable for MVP but recommend a small modal in a follow-up.
Trailing whitespace in template name is stripped (good); empty/whitespace-only names short-circuit (good).
seed_data_creation: Created template 'ACME QA Template' (id=08a73290-2cf1-4d08-a6ce-358632699fdc) via UI. Per request note this is harmless to leave behind; not deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workflow validated: /crm inline login -> ?tab=settings -> settings-tab-products -> products-import-wizard-btn -> plw-file-input upload -> mapping-step renders templates bar. Sheet checkbox testid hyphenates spaces: plw-sheet-select-Catalogue-2026. Dialog handler MUST be registered on `page.on('dialog')` BEFORE clicking plw-template-save — Playwright auto-dismisses prompts otherwise. After applying a saved template, mapping select count was unchanged (6 non-empty before, 6 after) because acme_name_only auto-detected the same mapping the template stored — this is expected, not a regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All wired endpoints (POST /api/crm/price-list/import-templates, GET list, mapping apply) integrate correctly with the React wizard.
